coprocessor_topology.name: Apple Storage Processor 3 (ASP3) / ANS2
coprocessor_topology.execution_mode: Bare-metal Preload Executable under RTKit OS

journal_clog_engine.name: CLog v2 (Commit Log) Journaling Architecture
features: Transactional FTL metadata persistence across power-loss events
Fast restart recovery via forward-scanned checkpoint logs (clog_load.c)

garbage_collection_wear_leveling.name: Adaptive Multi-Band Wear Leveling & GC
features: SLC Cache Mode (oSLC) with dynamic fold-down into TLC/QLC bands
Read Disturb mitigation with autonomous sampler thresholds (readdisturb.c)
Grown Bad Block (GBB) retirement tracking and autonomous reallocation

hardware_raid_parity.name: Inter-Die Hardware Parity & Reconstruction
features: Hardware-accelerated XOR parity generation across multi-plane dies
Single-die and multi-die defect tolerant read reconstruction (raid_hw_common.c)

hardware_crypto_tweak.name: Hardware AES-XTS NAND Encryption Pipeline
features: On-the-fly streaming AES-XTS cipher engine between Host-to-Flash (H2F) and Flash-to-Host (F2H)
Per-block 128-bit cryptographic tweak derived from LBA, Namespace ID, and Segment Index
Hardware key ladder integration via Effaceable Storage (Namespace 7)
